name: Severian semantic quality corpus v1 (round-two remediation P0-E)
status: FROZEN — valid for round-two model-selection evidence
content_sha256_note: content_sha256 is the canonical hash over {observations, query_pairs} only (corpus_sha256() in the generator); file_sha256 covers the committed JSON file bytes. Both are pinned by tests/benchmarks/test_corpus_provenance.py.

privacy.method: regex detectors (email, phone, api-key, bearer, home-path, live-store, dsn); fail-closed on any hit; aggregate counts/hashes only, never corpus text

determinism: build_corpus(seed=20260810) regenerates byte-identical output (verified 2026-08-10); tests/benchmarks/test_corpus_provenance.py pins the frozen hashes and byte identity
contract: >= 20% non-English quality queries across >= 4 non-English languages including >= 1 non-Latin script, each with a language code and provenance
genuine semantic paraphrases (different token sets, not token permutations)
real correction chains: stale old fact + superseding new fact with explicit supersession identity; current-fact and historical-fact queries expect DIFFERENT evidence
real temporal before/after pairs with explicit expected evidence
labelled answerable fact/code/task/long/crosslang probes and a separately labelled unanswerable negative/adversarial set
deterministic structural validator (validate_corpus) — semantic quality additionally relies on manual review of the committed corpus JSON
